title: DeepSeek-V4
before: Million-token context was a closed-model feature.
problem: Open models could not match frontier context length at usable cost.
breakthrough: A very large sparse MoE with a million-token context under MIT, built on the sparse attention from V3.2.
why: It brought frontier-scale long context into open weights, and kept downward pressure on frontier pricing.
inherits: Open weights competing on context length and price.
